questions.stem: Insha'in 'Yadda ake noman gyaɗa' insha'i ne na
questions.explanation: Explaining how something is done is an expository essay (bayani).

questions.stem: Wasiƙar da ka rubuta wa abokinka domin ka gaishe shi ana kiranta wasiƙar
questions.explanation: A letter to a friend is a friendly (informal) letter.

questions.stem: Insha'in 'Ranar da na fara hawan jirgin sama' insha'i ne na
questions.explanation: Recounting an event in sequence is narrative (labari).

questions.stem: A cikin insha'i na muhawara, marubuci yakan
options: kawo hujjoji domin goyon bayan ra'ayinsa
questions.explanation: An argumentative essay presents reasons and evidence to support a position.

questions.stem: Harufan Hausa masu ƙugiya guda nawa ne?
questions.explanation: The hooked letters are ɓ, ɗ, ƙ and ƴ.

questions.stem: Kalmar 'makaranta' tana da gaɓoɓi nawa?
questions.explanation: ma-ka-ran-ta has four syllables.

questions.stem: Wace gaɓa ce rufaffiya a cikin kalmar 'makaranta'?
questions.explanation: ran ends in a consonant (BWB), so it is closed; the others end in vowels.

questions.stem: Wanne baƙi ne ake furtawa a maƙogwaro?
questions.explanation: /h/ is produced in the throat (glottal).

questions.stem: Wace kalma ce dukkan gaɓoɓinta buɗaɗɗu ne?
questions.explanation: ku-je-ra has only open syllables; ƙar-, -ran-, gul- and gan- are closed.

questions.stem: Tagwayen wasulan Hausa su ne
questions.explanation: Hausa has two diphthongs: ai and au.

questions.stem: Jam'in 'rago' shi ne
questions.explanation: The plural of rago (ram) is raguna.

questions.stem: Jam'in 'mutum' shi ne
questions.explanation: The plural of mutum is mutane.

questions.stem: Jinsin mace na 'zaki' shi ne
questions.explanation: A lioness is zakanya.

questions.stem: Jinsin mace na 'malami' shi ne
questions.explanation: The feminine of malami is malama; malamai is the plural.

questions.stem: Wakilin suna na mutum na biyu jam'i shi ne
questions.explanation: ku is second person plural; mu first plural; su third plural.

questions.stem: Wace jumla ce take nuna aikin da ake yawan yi a matsayin al'ada?
questions.explanation: The -kan form (yakan) marks habitual action.

questions.stem: Korewar 'Za su tafi' ita ce
questions.explanation: Future negation is Ba ... ba around the future form: Ba za su tafi ba.

questions.topic: Word Structure and Word Formation (Ginin kalmomi)
questions.stem: Kalmar 'mabuɗi' tana nuna
questions.explanation: ma-...-i can form instrument nouns: mabuɗi (key, opener) from buɗe.

questions.stem: A cikin jumlar 'Yaro ya ci abinci', aikatau shi ne
questions.explanation: ci (eat) is the verb.

questions.topic: Structure and Types of Sentences (Tsari da ire-iren jumloli)
questions.stem: Jumlar 'Ka rufe ƙofa!' jumla ce ta
questions.explanation: It gives an order: a command sentence (umarni).

questions.stem: Kalmar da mai ba da tatsuniya yake amfani da ita wajen kammala tatsuniya ita ce
options: Ga ta nan ga ta nanku
questions.explanation: Kurunkus (kan kusu) closes a folktale; Ga ta nan ga ta nanku opens it.

questions.stem: 'Sannu ba ta hana zuwa' misali ne na
questions.explanation: It is a proverb: slow and steady still arrives.

questions.stem: Mawaƙin baka wanda ya shahara a duk ƙasar Hausa, kuma makaɗan kalangu suke yi masa kiɗa, shi ne
questions.explanation: Mamman Shata was accompanied by kalangu drummers.

questions.stem: Waƙa ko magana mai ɗauke da suka da tozarta wani a fili ana kiranta
questions.explanation: Zambo is open satire or derision.

questions.stem: Babban amfanin tatsuniya ga yara shi ne
questions.explanation: Folktales teach moral lessons and entertain.

questions.stem: Ibrahim Narambaɗa ya shahara a fagen
questions.explanation: Narambaɗa was a celebrated royal praise singer.

questions.stem: Wa ya rubuta littafin 'Magana Jari Ce'?
questions.explanation: Magana Jari Ce is a collection of stories by Abubakar Imam.

questions.stem: Littafin 'Gandoki' aikin wane marubuci ne?
questions.explanation: Gandoki was written by Muhammadu Bello Kagara.

questions.stem: A rubutacciyar waƙa, rukunin ɗangogi da ake rerawa tare ana kiransa
questions.explanation: A stanza in Hausa poetry is baiti; each line is ɗango.

questions.stem: Sautin da ke maimaituwa a ƙarshen ɗangogin waƙa ana kiransa
questions.explanation: Rhyme in Hausa poetry is amsa-amo.

questions.stem: Gaisuwar da ake yi wa mutumin da yake aiki ita ce
questions.explanation: Sannu da aiki greets someone at work.

questions.stem: Ta'aziyya ana yin ta ne ga
questions.explanation: Ta'aziyya is condolence on a death.

questions.stem: A al'adar Hausawa, ɗabi'ar da ake son yaro ya nuna wa iyaye da manya ita ce
questions.explanation: Obedience and good manners are central to Hausa upbringing.

questions.stem: Kalmar 'karimci' tana nufin
questions.explanation: Karimci is generosity and hospitality.

questions.stem: A al'adar Hausawa, uwa ba ta kiran sunan ɗanta na fari saboda
questions.explanation: The custom of kunyar ɗan fari: a mother avoids calling her first child by name out of modesty.

questions.stem: Al'adar gargajiya ta hawan iskoki da rawa ana kiranta
questions.explanation: Bori is the traditional spirit-possession cult.

questions.stem: Mai sana'ar rini ana kiransa
questions.explanation: A dyer is marini; maƙeri is a blacksmith and masaƙi a weaver.

questions.stem: Mutumin da ke ba da maganin gargajiya na ganye da saiwa ana kiransa
questions.explanation: A traditional herbalist is boka.

questions.topic: Traditional Authority and Office Holding (Sarautun gargajiya)
questions.stem: Shugaban unguwa a tsarin sarautar gargajiya ana kiransa
questions.explanation: The ward head is mai unguwa; dagaci heads a village and hakimi a district.

questions.stem: Wasan tseren dawakai ana kiransa
questions.explanation: Sukuwa is horse racing.

questions.stem:
Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan, ka rubuta insha'i mai kalmomi kusan ɗari uku:
(a) Amfanin wayar salula ga ɗalibai.
(b) Bikin Sallah a garinmu.
(c) Wasiƙa zuwa ga shugaban makarantarku kana neman izinin hutun kwana uku. [25 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
10 marks: Content: relevant, well-developed ideas suited to the type chosen
5 marks: Organisation: introduction, logical paragraphs, conclusion; correct formal letter layout for (c)
7 marks: Expression: idiomatic Hausa with apt karin magana and varied sentences
3 marks: Mechanical accuracy: official orthography (hooked letters), spelling and punctuation
questions.explanation: (a) is argumentative/expository, (b) descriptive or narrative, (c) a formal letter. A strong answer plans introduction, body and conclusion, uses idiomatic Hausa with proverbs and writes the hooked letters correctly.

questions.stem:
(a) Lissafa gajerun wasulan Hausa guda biyar. [5 marks]
(b) Mene ne tagwayen wasula? Ka ba da su biyu tare da misalin kalma ɗaya ga kowanne. [4 marks]
(c) Mene ne karin sauti? Ka ambaci nau'o'in karin sauti uku na Hausa. [6 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
1 mark: a
1 mark: e
1 mark: i
1 mark: o
1 mark: u
2 marks: Diphthongs are two vowel sounds glided together in one syllable: ai, e.g. kai
2 marks: au, e.g. sauri
3 marks: Tone is the pitch level on a syllable that can change the meaning of a word
1 mark: High tone
1 mark: Low tone
1 mark: Falling tone
questions.explanation: The short vowels are a, e, i, o, u. The diphthongs are ai (kai) and au (sauri). Tone is meaningful pitch; Hausa has high, low and falling tones.

questions.stem:
(a) Ba da jam'in waɗannan kalmomi: rago, ɗaki, mutum, birni, kujera. [5 marks]
(b) Bayyana yadda ake samar da suna da ɗafin ma-...-i don nuna (i) mai yin aiki (ii) kayan aiki, ka ba da misali ɗaya-ɗaya. [6 marks]
(c) Ba da korewar waɗannan jumloli: (i) Za su tafi. (ii) Ina karatu. [4 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
1 mark: rago - raguna
1 mark: ɗaki - ɗakuna
1 mark: mutum - mutane
1 mark: birni - birane
1 mark: kujera - kujeru
3 marks: Agent: ma- prefixed and -i suffixed to a verb root, e.g. noma - manomi
3 marks: Instrument: same affix gives tools, e.g. buɗe - mabuɗi
2 marks: Ba za su tafi ba
2 marks: Ba na karatu
questions.explanation: Plurals: raguna, ɗakuna, mutane, birane, kujeru. ma-...-i gives agents (manomi) and instruments (mabuɗi). Negatives: Ba za su tafi ba; Ba na karatu.

questions.stem:
(a) Mene ne karin magana? [3 marks]
(b) Kawo karin magana uku, ka bayyana ma'anar kowanne. [9 marks]
(c) Faɗi amfani biyu na karin magana a cikin magana. [3 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
3 marks: A short traditional saying expressing wisdom or truth in figurative language
3 marks: First proverb and meaning, e.g. Sannu ba ta hana zuwa: patience still achieves its aim
3 marks: Second proverb and meaning, e.g. Hannu da yawa maganin ƙazamar miya: many hands make light work
3 marks: Third proverb and meaning, e.g. Komai nisan jifa, ƙasa zai faɗo: everything has an end
2 marks: Makes speech beautiful and persuasive
1 mark: Teaches morals and preserves wisdom
questions.explanation: A proverb is a short wise saying. Examples: Sannu ba ta hana zuwa; Hannu da yawa maganin ƙazamar miya; Komai nisan jifa ƙasa zai faɗo. Proverbs beautify speech and teach morals.

questions.stem:
(a) Bayyana waɗannan kalmomi a nazarin rubutacciyar waƙa: (i) baiti (ii) ɗango (iii) amsa-amo (iv) jigo. [8 marks]
(b) Ambaci marubutan zube biyu da littafi ɗaya na kowannensu. [4 marks]
(c) Faɗi bambanci ɗaya tsakanin waƙar baka da rubutacciyar waƙa. [3 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
2 marks: Baiti: a stanza, a group of lines
2 marks: Ɗango: a single line of a stanza
2 marks: Amsa-amo: rhyme, a sound repeated at line ends
2 marks: Jigo: the main theme or message
2 marks: First writer and book, e.g. Abubakar Imam, Ruwan Bagaja or Magana Jari Ce
2 marks: Second writer and book, e.g. Muhammadu Bello Kagara, Gandoki; Abubakar Tafawa Ɓalewa, Shaihu Umar
3 marks: Oral song is composed and performed live, often with instruments, and varies with each performance; written poetry is composed in writing with fixed stanzas and read or chanted
questions.explanation: Baiti is a stanza, ɗango a line, amsa-amo rhyme and jigo theme. Prose writers include Abubakar Imam (Ruwan Bagaja) and Bello Kagara (Gandoki). Oral song is performed and variable; written poetry is fixed in text.

questions.topic: Traditional Authority and Office Holding (Sarautun gargajiya)
questions.stem:
(a) Ambaci sarautun gargajiya guda shida a masarautar Hausa. [6 marks]
(b) Bayyana ayyukan masu riƙe da sarautu uku daga cikinsu. [9 marks]
questions.markingGuide:
1 mark: Sarki
1 mark: Waziri
1 mark: Galadima
1 mark: Madawaki
1 mark: Hakimi
1 mark: Dagaci or Mai unguwa
3 marks: Waziri: chief adviser to the emir and head of the council
3 marks: Madawaki: traditionally commander of the cavalry and army in war
3 marks: Hakimi, Dagaci or Mai unguwa: administer district, village or ward, collect dues and settle disputes
questions.explanation: Titles include Sarki, Waziri, Galadima, Madawaki, Hakimi, Dagaci and Mai unguwa. The Waziri advises the emir, the Madawaki led the cavalry, and district, village and ward heads administer their areas and settle disputes.
